notes.text_en: We're organizing EVENTS in İZMİR and İSTANBUL. We are interested in making events in other places as well.
notes.text_tr: İZMİR ve İSTANBUL'da ETKİNLİKLER düzenliyoruz Diğer yerlerde de etkinlikler yapmak istiyoruz.
notes.more_en: if you have a space to offer for our events we would like to hear about it.
notes.more_tr: Eğer önermek istediğiniz mekanlar varsa duymak isteriz.

notes.text_en: Uncivilization LABEL is on fair music platforms: [mirlo](https://mirlo.space/uncivilization/), [fairplayer](https://fairplayer.band/player/artist/uncivilization@mirlo.space), [bandwagon](https://bandwagon.fm/@uncivilization), [acidnation](https://www.acidnation.com/label/uncivilization), [audius](https://audius.co/uncivilization), [artcore](https://www.artcore.com/uncivilization), [distrosub](https://www.distrosub.com/label/uncivilization), [itch.io](https://unciv.itch.io/), [bandcamp](https://uncivilization.bandcamp.com) and [soundcloud](https://soundcloud.com/uncvl).
notes.text_tr: Uncivilization LABEL adil müzik platformlarında: [mirlo](https://mirlo.space/uncivilization/), [fairplayer](https://fairplayer.band/player/artist/uncivilization@mirlo.space), [bandwagon](https://bandwagon.fm/@uncivilization), [acidnation](https://www.acidnation.com/label/uncivilization), [audius](https://audius.co/uncivilization), [artcore](https://www.artcore.com/uncivilization), [distrosub](https://www.distrosub.com/label/uncivilization), [itch.io](https://unciv.itch.io/), [bandcamp](https://uncivilization.bandcamp.com) and [soundcloud](https://soundcloud.com/uncvl).
notes.more_en: If you are a music producer and you are into bass, breakcore, hardcore or punk, consider sending us your tunes. Check our [sound](https://uncvl.xyz/sound/) page for complete list of music genres we consider for Uncivilization.
notes.more_tr: Eğer bir müzik yapımcısıysanız ve bass, breakcore, hardcore veya punk türlerine ilgi duyuyorsanız, bize parçalarınızı göndermeyi düşünebilirsiniz. Uncivilization için değerlendirdiğimiz müzik türlerinin tam listesi için [ses](https://uncvl.xyz/sound/) sayfamıza göz atın.
